title: Security Hardening
description: Essential security configuration checklist for new WordPress sites.

steps.title: Disable File Editor
steps.instructions: Confirm DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT is set in wp-config.php to prevent theme/plugin editing from admin.

steps.title: Force SSL for Admin
steps.instructions: Ensure FORCE_SSL_ADMIN is enabled in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Restrict XML-RPC
steps.instructions: Disable or restrict XML-RPC if not needed for Jetpack or mobile apps.

steps.title: Remove WP Version from Head
steps.instructions: Verify wp_generator meta tag is removed from public pages.

steps.title: Install Login Protection
steps.instructions: Install and configure a login limiter or WAF rule for brute-force protection.
